source: X. Liang, arXiv:2609.22618v1 Sec. III.B: 'The tensor-backflow wave function used in this work was optimized in the previous literature [25]. The wave function was initialized with U_UHF = 4, and the converged energies were -0.7370(3) for p = 0 and -0.7419(2) for p = 1.' Ref. 25 is PRB 113, 155121 (arXiv:2507.01856), Table VI, which prints the same state without error bars.
note: The PRB row (Table VI, NNN backflow, U_UHF = 4, Ep = 0, printed -0.7370) is this state; the later paper by the same author gives its error bar (ruled 2026-11-10, qmbl-verify 2026-11-10b).

source: X. Liang, arXiv:2609.22618v1 Sec. III.B: 'The tensor-backflow wave function used in this work was optimized in the previous literature [25]. The wave function was initialized with U_UHF = 4, and the converged energies were -0.7370(3) for p = 0 and -0.7419(2) for p = 1.' Ref. 25 is PRB 113, 155121 (arXiv:2507.01856), Table VI, which prints the same state without error bars.
note: The PRB row (Table VI, NNN backflow, U_UHF = 4, Ep = 1, printed -0.7420) is this state after one Lanczos step; the later paper prints -0.7419(2), within its bar of the PRB value, and gives the error bar (ruled 2026-11-10, qmbl-verify 2026-11-10b). The row keeps the PRB's energy.
